$comment: Safari's overrides, merged after patches/manifest.shiori.json (see there for the rules).
$comment_permissions: Upstream also asks for 'cookies', which only serves 'Authenticate with Browser Session'. Shiori talks to a token-less server gated by the network, so it is dropped. nativeMessaging reaches the app (ext/host-native.js). scripts/build-extension.sh fails if upstream adds a permission this list does not account for.
$comment_commands: Safari does apply suggested_key (it showed upstream's as ⇧⌘I/B/Y, and ⇧⌘Y is macOS's New Sticky Note), so Shiori's are Control-Shift (patches/manifest.shiori.json); the user can change them in Safari → Settings → Extensions. More than four suggested shortcuts and Safari drops the background silently (it broke Safari's search; build-extension.sh checks). iOS has none.
